name: makeit
description: Tablero Kanban colaborativo en tiempo real (monorepo: /server + /client)

scripts.install:all: npm ci && npm ci --prefix server && npm ci --prefix client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix client && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --prefix server && npm run test:coverage --prefix client
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
